title: Liam's baked PDF contradicts its own Documents Provided section — prose claims the landlord reference is an attachment while the report lists it as Not provided
evidence: pdf_report_data.gleam:1352 (application_completeness note): "One document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other attachment. The form is the thinnest in the demo universe on corroboration." — and pdf_report_data.gleam:1279 (insight): "But only one document beyond the landlord reference — payslips — is on file, and no character reference was provided". But pdf_prebake.gleam:695-697: 'a-liam' -> [ base_doc("doc-liam-1", "proof_of_income", "payslips.pdf"), ] — i.e. exactly one document, no landlord-reference document. pdftotext of the shipped server/priv/static/demo/report-a-liam.pdf confirms both sides render in the same PDF: "One document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other attachment." appears alongside the Documents Provided rollup "Landlord reference / Not provided". (Screen↔PDF parity itself holds — client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam documents_for("a-liam") is also payslips-only — the contradiction is internal to the PDF prose.)
detail: The report asserts the landlord reference is on file as an attachment while its own Documents Provided section says Not provided. Undermines the real-audit-credibility goal in a shipped marketing asset.
recommended_fix: Reword Liam's insight and completeness note to say the landlord reference is a form contact only (no letter uploaded), matching documents_for's single payslips entry.

title: competition_ranks logic duplicated verbatim between demo store and server handler — a shared/ helper is importable by both
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1075-1084: "/// Port of `vacancy/application_list_handler.gleam` /// `competition_ranks` so the demo's rank labels + Compare-top-3 gate /// behave exactly like the real app's. pub fn competition_ranks( scores: List(Option(Int)), start start: Int, ) -> List(Option(Int)) {" — a byte-identical copy of application_list_handler.gleam:231-264: "pub fn competition_ranks( scores: List(Option(Int)), start start: Int, ) -> List(Option(Int)) { do_competition_ranks(scores, start, None, None, []) |> list.reverse }" (do_competition_ranks also copied line-for-line). The client package cannot import server modules, but the function is pure over List(Option(Int)) and both packages already import shared/.
detail: The port is documented and faithful today, but two copies of the rank/tie algorithm can drift silently if the real one changes — and the demo's Compare-top-3 gate depends on identical semantics.
recommended_fix: Hoist competition_ranks/do_competition_ranks into shared/ (e.g. shared/leaderboard_rank.gleam) and have both application_list_handler and demo_store import it.
